entities.summary: Maja Nylén Persson is a Swedish ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the New York Sirens of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL). A member of the Swedish national team, she was drafted tenth overall in the second round of the 2024 PWHL draft by New York.
